solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Wine container church required to hold a service

indicators.note: the church letters are required to hold, so they wrap round, the other pieces

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the RAF, the Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A church needs a jug of wine before it can hold its service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hold' puts A and RAF inside C...E.
explanation.definitionFit: A carafe is a glass jug, a vessel for serving wine at table.

clue.text: What rock bands may make, some of them occasionally?

definitions.text: What rock bands may make, some of them occasionally?

parts.words: What rock bands may make, some of them occasionally?
parts.note: old rock groups sometimes reunite and return to performing after years away

explanation.surface: What some ageing rock bands do every so often.
explanation.definitionFit: A return to performing after retirement is a reappearance on the music scene.

clue.text: Verbally trash small pleasure area

indicators.note: verbally signals the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: to trash something is to wreck it

explanation.surface: Insulting a small amusement park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small' signals a shortened word: rec is short for recreation ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A rec, recreation ground, is a public park for games and leisure.

clue.text: First of Friesians run round rings: with this disease?

indicators.note: first of asks for the initial letter of the word Friesians

parts.note: two Os look like rings
to trot round is to make a quick run round

explanation.surface: Black-and-white cows trotting round a ring: are they lame?
explanation.definitionFit: Footrot is a bacterial infection of the hooves in sheep and cattle.

clue.text: Mad attempt to park initially in reverse

parts.note: to have a crack at something is to make an attempt

indicators.note: in reverse says the words to and the initial before it are read backwards
initially asks for the opening letter of the word park

explanation.surface: A crazy try at reversing a car into a parking space.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in reverse' turns TO + P into POT.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot is an eccentric or crazy person, and as an adjective it means mad or absurd.

clue.text: Survey study written in Dante's time

indicators.note: written in places the study inside the historical period

parts.note: Dante lived at the dawn of the Italian Renaissance
to con is to study or learn

explanation.surface: A literary study composed in the age of the Divine Comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written in' is the container signal; con, meaning to study, is an old word that survives mostly in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Reconnaissance is an inspection or survey of ground, especially military.

clue.text: Instrument with keys the French army used?

parts.note: C and E are musical keys
les is French for the (plural)
the TA was Britain's Territorial Army, its volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: A keyboard instrument played by French soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A celesta is a small keyboard percussion instrument with bell-like tones.

clue.text: Polls Liberal held in various bits and pieces

indicators.note: held in says the Liberal letter is contained by the rest
various signals the letters of bits and pieces are varied in order

explanation.surface: Election results with the Liberals spread across many fragments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'various' shuffles the two words into PEBISCITES, and 'held in' slots L in as the second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Plebiscites are direct votes by the whole electorate, a kind of poll.

clue.text: Sweetheart standing on youth leader's foot

indicators.note: in a down clue standing on puts the sweetheart above the youth letter

parts.note: toots is an affectionate address for a sweetheart

indicators.note: leader's asks for the first letter of the word youth

explanation.surface: A girlfriend steps on a youth club leader's foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Tootsy is a childish or playful word for a toe or little foot.

clue.text: Go-ahead, like monarchist outside hospital offices?

indicators.note: outside says the monarchist letters go round the others

parts.note: a monarchist is for the king: 'for king'
a ward is part of a hospital
the offices is an old euphemism for the lavatory

explanation.surface: A royalist stands outside hospital offices, ready to press on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' is the container signal; 'the offices' is an old British euphemism for the toilets, hence LOO.
explanation.definitionFit: Go-ahead as an adjective means progressive and enterprising, planning for the future.

clue.text: The writer's bird and mollusc, say, like some bacilli?

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is spoken, giving a word that sounds like it

parts.note: the writer's is MY, a bird is a CROW, a mollusc is a COCKLE: together 'my crow cockle'

explanation.surface: A writer lists their pet bird and a shellfish, asking if they resemble bacteria.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The writer's' is the setter speaking: MY.
explanation.definitionFit: Micrococci are spherical bacteria; the question mark admits that rod-shaped bacilli are only loosely the same family of germs.

clue.text: Business established by end of village green

indicators.note: end of asks for the final letter of the word village

parts.note: CO is short for company, a business

explanation.surface: A shop set up beside the village green.
explanation.definitionFit: Eco is a prefix-adjective for environmentally friendly things, as green is.

clue.text: Distribute drink around east of France

indicators.note: around says the drink letters go round the French east

parts.note: a brew is a drink, especially tea or beer
EST is the French word for east

explanation.surface: Handing out drinks across eastern France.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestrew is to scatter or strew about, an old word for spreading things around.

clue.text: Chunky quad bike's first I invested in last month

parts.note: a quad, quadrangle, is a square courtyard

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of the word bike
invested in says the I is put inside the letters for last month

parts.note: ult., ultimo, means of last month in old letter style

explanation.surface: A sturdy quad bike bought last month.
explanation.definitionFit: Square-built describes a broad, stocky, solidly built frame.

clue.text: Article recalled tips for horrific videos?

definitions.note: video nasties were violent horror films on tape banned in 1980s Britain

indicators.note: recalled, called back, says the article is read backwards

parts.note: AN is the indefinite article
a tip is a messy place, as is a pigsty, so tips are sties

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece reports hints about gruesome films.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tips' looks like hints but means rubbish dumps, i.e. sties.
explanation.definitionFit: Video nasties was the British tabloid term for gory horror films on VHS.

clue.text: Weight of chap in bar with British engineer

indicators.note: in places the chap inside the pieces that follow it

parts.note: a counter is the bar in a pub or shop
CE is a civil engineer
Alan is a man's name, standing for any chap

explanation.surface: How heavy a man in a pub is, along with a British engineer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal: the chap sits inside the bar-plus-engineer string, after its B.
explanation.definitionFit: A counterbalance is a weight that offsets another weight.

clue.text: Favourable directions in force, delivered extremely loftily

parts.note: F is the symbol for force in physics

indicators.note: in places the directions inside the pieces that follow

parts.note: to be rid of is to be delivered from
E and N are compass directions, east and north

indicators.note: extremely asks for the outer letters of the word loftily

explanation.surface: Kind instructions given within the force, spoken in a very haughty way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the two compass points inside force-plus-delivered; 'extremely' takes the outer letters of loftily.
explanation.definitionFit: Friendly conditions or winds are favourable, helpful ones.

clue.text: Repairman beginning to tackle siren, accepting foreign cash

indicators.note: accepting says the first pieces take in the money
beginning to asks for the first letter of the word tackle

parts.note: a hooter is a siren or horn
roubles are Russian money

explanation.surface: A siren about to be dealt with, while foreign money changes hands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' is the container signal: the Russian money lands right after the opening letter of tackle.
explanation.definitionFit: A troubleshooter traces and fixes faults, as a repair mechanic does.

clue.text: University developed silent kitchen gadget

indicators.note: developed signals the letters of silent are reworked

explanation.surface: A university invents a quiet kitchen device.
explanation.definitionFit: A utensil is a tool for use in the kitchen.

clue.text: For several weeks, outside court, turned up to show further disapproval?

indicators.note: outside says the reversed jeering goes round the court letters
in a down clue turned up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to boo again is to reboo

explanation.surface: Protesters outside court for weeks keep returning to jeer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' makes OOBER, then CT sits inside.
explanation.definitionFit: October is a month, a period of several weeks.

clue.text: Declare a sure winner in speech

indicators.note: in speech says the phrase is heard aloud

parts.note: a cert is a certainty, a sure winner in racing

explanation.surface: Announcing a racing certainty.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert is to state firmly, to declare.

clue.text: Very low temperature press employee's Cockney idol reported

indicators.note: reported says the phrase is heard rather than written

parts.note: a sub, sub-editor, works for the press; a Cockney drops the H of hero, so the idol is 'ero: 'sub's 'ero'

explanation.surface: A newspaper worker's East London hero appears in the news.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys famously drop initial H, so hero becomes 'ero.
explanation.definitionFit: Subzero describes a reading below freezing, a very cold temperature.

clue.text: Cunning individual set out to be entertainer

parts.note: art means cunning or craftiness
I, the Roman one, is a single individual

indicators.note: out means the letters of set are put out of order

explanation.surface: A crafty person sets out to become a performer.
explanation.definitionFit: An artiste is a professional performer, a stage entertainer.

clue.text: Priest taking books from George or Thomas Stearns?

indicators.note: taking ... from signals the books are removed from the surname
this word says some letters are taken away from the word it governs

parts.note: George Eliot and Thomas Stearns Eliot share that surname
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A clergyman borrows books from one of two famous writers.
explanation.definitionFit: Eli was the high priest at Shiloh who raised Samuel in the Bible.

clue.text: Comic entering school management's communications centre

indicators.note: entering puts the comic inside the school letters

parts.note: a wit is a comic, a funny person
a board of directors is a company's management

explanation.surface: A comedian joins a school's governing body's office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' is the container signal; 'Comic' looks like an adjective but is a noun, a funny person.
explanation.definitionFit: A switchboard is where telephone calls are routed, a hub for communications.

clue.text: Bristle, displaying anger with new leaders

indicators.note: leaders asks for the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Bristling with fury at the new bosses.
explanation.definitionFit: An awn is a stiff bristle on the head of barley or other grasses.

clue.text: Get a lute repaired, giving instruction

indicators.note: repaired means the letters are fixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: Having a musical instrument mended and receiving lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutelage is teaching or guidance given by a tutor.

clue.text: Attempt to secure half of pitch with it

indicators.note: to secure means the attempt holds the half pitch inside it

parts.note: a try is an attempt
each team defends one end, half of a sports pitch

explanation.surface: A sporting effort to take one half of the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to secure' is the container signal; a try is also a rugby score, which suits the pitch in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with it means being fashionable and up to date.
